uk.B: Піднімися в Гілеад і здобудь бальзаму, \q Діво, Доню Єгипте! \q Ти пробувала ліки за ліками, але даремно; \q немає зцілення для тебе.
uk.R: Піднімися в Гілеад і візьми цілющого бальзаму, \q народе Єгипту, гордий, як молода дівчина! \q Але всі твої ліки марні. \q Ніщо тебе не зцілить.

decisions.choice: balm from Gilead: the cure that cannot heal
decisions.reason: Gilead, east of the Jordan, was known for a healing resin traded to Egypt (Genesis 37:25). In 8:22 Jeremiah asked whether there was no balm in Gilead for his own people; here Egypt is mockingly told to fetch it, and it will do no good. Babylon is told the same in 51:8.

decisions.choice: virgin daughter of Egypt: the land and its people pictured as a young woman never conquered
decisions.reason: Cities and peoples are pictured as daughters ("daughter Zion"), and "virgin" marks one never yet taken by an enemy (Isaiah 23:12; 47:1). Egypt, proud and untouched, now has a wound that will not heal.

decisions.choice: you have multiplied: the reading aloud, with the same meaning as the written text
alternatives: the written form, with the same sense
decisions.reason: The written text has an older spelling of the ending "you" (to a woman), which the scribes marked to be read in the usual form. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: new skin: the fresh skin that grows over a healing wound
decisions.reason: The word is used in 30:13, "remedies, new skin, there are none for you", of Zion's wound. Egypt's wound, like Zion's, will not close.

decisions.choice: Virgin Daughter Egypt (Balanced); people of Egypt, proud as a young woman (Readable); healing
decisions.reason: Balanced follows Isaiah 47:1, "Virgin Daughter Babylon". Readable says who is addressed and what the picture means (m2). Balanced and Readable say "healing" for new skin, as 30:13 does.

decisions.choice: virgen hija de Egipto (L, B); pueblo de Egipto, orgulloso como una joven (R)
decisions.reason: Daughter Egypt follows the wording set for daughter Zion: "hija de" at Literal and Balanced, "pueblo de" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "bikira binti Misri" (L); "Bikira Binti Misri" (B); "watu wa Misri" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "daughter Zion" and "daughter Babylon" in Swahili, applied to Egypt: a picture of the nation at Literal, a title at Balanced, the people at Readable.

decisions.choice: "vierge, fille de l’Égypte" (L), "vierge, fille d’Égypte" (B), "peuple d’Égypte, fier comme une jeune fille" (R)
decisions.reason: The figure of a nation as a daughter follows the wording set for "daughter Zion" in French ("la fille de Sion" at Literal and Balanced, "le peuple de Sion" at Readable).

decisions.choice: trinh nữ, con gái Ai Cập (L); con gái đồng trinh Ai Cập (B); dân Ai Cập, kiêu hãnh như một thiếu nữ (R)
decisions.reason: The pattern set for "daughter Zion": the image kept at Literal and Balanced, the people named at Readable. A nation addressed is "ngươi" at every level.

decisions.choice: "처녀 딸 이집트" (L, B); "젊은 여자처럼 교만한 이집트 백성" (R)
decisions.reason: Following "처녀 딸 시온" in 2 Kings 19:21 (*betulah*), as the terms note sets for the daughter figures.

decisions.choice: "유향" for the balm of Gilead
decisions.reason: The resin of Gilead, used as medicine (8:22); Readable says what it was for.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Egypt as a woman); virgem, filha do Egito (B)
decisions.reason: Egypt is addressed as a young woman (m2), so with "tu" at every level, as Isaiah speaks to Babylon; Balanced writes the title as Isaiah 47:1 does in Portuguese, "virgem, filha da Babilônia", in lower case. "Bálsamo" and "Gileade" as 8:22.

decisions.choice: balm "በለሳን"; the virgin daughter of Egypt "ድንግሊቱ የግብፅ ልጅ" (Literal, Balanced), Readable as its English.
decisions.reason: The terms list's pattern for "the daughter of Zion" (L "የጽዮን ልጅ"), applied to Egypt; Gilead "ገለዓድ" as on main.

decisions.choice: मिस्र की कुँवारी बेटी (L, B), addressed with तुम
decisions.reason: Virgin daughter as the Hindi of Isaiah 23:12 and 47:1 ("X की कुँवारी बेटी"). God and the prophet address a city or people with तुम, as the prophets brief sets it. The balm of Gilead is बलसान, as Jeremiah 8:22 in Hindi.

decisions.choice: "бальзам" in Gilead; "дева, дочь Египта" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Balm of Gilead as in 8:22, and the virgin daughter in the form of Isaiah 47:1 in this translation ("дева, дочь Вавилона") (m2).

decisions.choice: "нет тебе новой кожи"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of fresh skin growing over a healing wound (m4); Balanced and Readable speak of healing.

source.text: שָׁמְע֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ קְלוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְצִוְחָתֵ֖ךְ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־גִבּ֤וֹר בְּגִבּוֹר֙ כָּשָׁ֔לוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו נָפְל֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Have heard [the] nations your shame, and your outcry has filled the earth; for warrior against warrior they have stumbled, together they have fallen, the two of them.

en.L: The nations have heard of your shame, \q and your outcry has filled the earth; \q for warrior has stumbled against warrior; \q together they have fallen, the two of them.
en.B: The nations have heard of your disgrace; \q the earth is full of your cries. \q One warrior has stumbled over another, \q and both have fallen together.
en.R: The nations have heard how you were shamed. \q Your cries fill the whole earth. \q Your soldiers trip over each other, \q and they all fall down together.

es.L: Las naciones oyeron tu afrenta, \q y tu clamor llenó la tierra; \q porque el valiente tropezó contra el valiente, \q y cayeron juntos los dos.
es.B: Las naciones se enteraron de tu deshonra; \q la tierra está llena de tus gritos. \q Un guerrero tropezó con otro, \q y los dos cayeron juntos.
es.R: Las naciones oyeron cómo fuiste humillado. \q Tus gritos llenan toda la tierra. \q Tus soldados tropiezan unos con otros, \q y todos caen juntos.

fr.L: Les nations ont entendu ta honte, \q et ton cri a rempli la terre ; \q car le guerrier a trébuché contre le guerrier, \q ensemble ils sont tombés, tous les deux.
fr.B: Les nations ont appris ton déshonneur ; \q la terre est pleine de tes cris. \q Un guerrier a trébuché sur un autre, \q et ils sont tombés tous les deux ensemble.
fr.R: Les nations ont appris comment tu as été humiliée. \q Tes cris remplissent toute la terre. \q Tes soldats trébuchent les uns sur les autres, \q et ils tombent tous ensemble.

sw.L: Mataifa wamesikia aibu yako, \q na kilio chako kimeijaza dunia; \q kwa maana shujaa amejikwaa juu ya shujaa; \q wameanguka pamoja, wote wawili.
sw.B: Mataifa wamesikia juu ya aibu yako; \q dunia imejaa vilio vyako. \q Shujaa mmoja amejikwaa juu ya mwingine, \q nao wote wawili wameanguka pamoja.
sw.R: Mataifa wamesikia jinsi ulivyoaibishwa. \q Vilio vyako vinaijaza dunia yote. \q Askari wako wanajikwaa juu ya wenzao, \q nao wote wanaanguka pamoja.

vi.L: Các dân tộc đã nghe về sự nhục nhã của ngươi, \q và tiếng kêu la của ngươi đầy dẫy khắp đất; \q vì dũng sĩ vấp vào dũng sĩ, \q cả hai cùng ngã chung.
vi.B: Các dân tộc đã nghe về nỗi nhục của ngươi; \q tiếng kêu la của ngươi vang khắp đất. \q Dũng sĩ này vấp vào dũng sĩ kia, \q và cả hai cùng ngã.
vi.R: Các dân tộc đã nghe ngươi bị sỉ nhục thế nào. \q Tiếng kêu khóc của ngươi vang khắp đất. \q Quân lính ngươi vấp vào nhau, \q và tất cả đều ngã xuống.

ko.L: 민족들이 네 수치를 들었고, \q 네 울부짖음이 땅에 가득하다. \q 용사가 용사에게 걸려 비틀거리고, \q 둘이 함께 쓰러졌기 때문이다.
ko.B: 민족들이 네가 당한 수치를 들었고, \q 온 땅에 네 울부짖음이 가득하다. \q 용사가 용사에게 걸려 넘어지고, \q 둘 다 함께 쓰러졌다.
ko.R: 민족들이 네가 수치를 당한 것을 들었다. \q 네 울부짖는 소리가 온 땅에 가득하다. \q 네 군인들이 서로 걸려 넘어지고, \q 모두 함께 쓰러진다.

pt.L: As nações ouviram a tua vergonha, \q e o teu clamor encheu a terra; \q pois guerreiro tropeçou em guerreiro; \q juntos caíram, os dois.
pt.B: As nações ouviram falar da tua desonra; \q a terra está cheia dos teus gritos. \q Um guerreiro tropeçou no outro, \q e os dois caíram juntos.
pt.R: As nações ouviram como foste humilhada. \q Os teus gritos enchem a terra inteira. \q Os teus soldados tropeçam uns nos outros, \q e todos caem juntos.

am.L: ሕዝቦች ኀፍረትሽን ሰሙ፤ \q ጩኸትሽም ምድርን ሞላ፤ \q ኃያል በኃያል ላይ ተሰናክሏልና፤ \q ሁለቱም በአንድነት ወደቁ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች ውርደትሽን ሰሙ፤ \q ምድርም በጩኸትሽ ተሞላች። \q አንዱ ጦረኛ በሌላው ላይ ተሰናከለ፤ \q ሁለቱም በአንድነት ወደቁ።
am.R: ሕዝቦች እንዴት እንዳፈርሽ ሰሙ። \q ጩኸትሽ ምድርን ሁሉ ሞላ። \q ወታደሮችሽ እርስ በርሳቸው ይሰናከላሉ፤ \q ሁሉም በአንድነት ይወድቃሉ።

hi.L: जातियों ने तुम्हारी लज्जा के विषय में सुना है, \q और तुम्हारी चिल्लाहट से पृथ्वी भर गई है; \q क्योंकि वीर योद्धा वीर योद्धा से ठोकर खाकर \q दोनों के दोनों एक साथ गिर पड़े हैं।
hi.B: देशों ने तुम्हारे अपमान के बारे में सुना है; \q पृथ्वी तुम्हारी चिल्लाहट से भर गई है। \q एक योद्धा दूसरे योद्धा से ठोकर खाकर गिरा है, \q और दोनों एक साथ गिर पड़े हैं।
hi.R: देशों ने सुना है कि तुम्हारा कैसा अपमान हुआ। \q तुम्हारी चीख़ें सारी पृथ्वी पर सुनाई देती हैं। \q तुम्हारे सैनिक एक-दूसरे से टकराकर गिरते हैं, \q और सब के सब एक साथ गिर पड़ते हैं।

ru.L: Услышали народы о твоём позоре, \q и твой вопль наполнил землю; \q ведь воин о воина споткнулся, \q вместе упали оба.
ru.B: Народы услышали о твоём бесчестии; \q земля полна твоих воплей. \q Воин споткнулся о воина, \q и оба упали вместе.
ru.R: Народы услышали, как тебя опозорили. \q Твои крики разносятся по всей земле. \q Твои воины спотыкаются друг о друга \q и все вместе падают.

uk.L: Народи почули про твою ганьбу, \q і твій крик наповнив землю; \q бо вояк спіткнувся об вояка; \q разом вони впали, обидва.
uk.B: Народи почули про твою ганьбу; \q земля повна твоїх криків. \q Один вояк спіткнувся об іншого, \q і обидва впали разом.
uk.R: Народи почули, як тебе осоромили. \q Твої крики наповнюють усю землю. \q Твої воїни спотикаються один об одного, \q і всі разом падають.

decisions.choice: warrior against warrior: in the rout the soldiers trip over each other
decisions.reason: The picture is of a panicked army running so close together that one man falls over another and both go down (compare Leviticus 26:37). It returns to the stumbling of verse 6.

decisions.choice: your shame ... your outcry: the disgrace of defeat and the cries of the beaten
decisions.reason: Egypt claimed it would cover the earth (verse 8). Now what fills the earth is the sound of its crying, and the nations hear of its humiliation.

decisions.choice: they all fall down together
decisions.reason: Readable makes the pair of fallen warriors stand for the whole army, which is what the picture means (m1).

source.text: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לָב֗וֹא נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: The word that spoke Yahweh to Jeremiah the prophet about [the] coming of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to strike [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: The word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt:
en.B: The word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon coming to attack the land of Egypt:
en.R: This is the message {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Jeremiah the prophet about the time when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon would come and attack Egypt:

es.L: La palabra que habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Jeremías el profeta acerca de la venida de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, para herir la tierra de Egipto:
es.B: La palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al profeta Jeremías acerca de la llegada de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, para atacar la tierra de Egipto:
es.R: Este es el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio al profeta Jeremías sobre el tiempo en que Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, vendría a atacar a Egipto:

fr.L: La parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Jérémie le prophète au sujet de la venue de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, pour frapper le pays d’Égypte :
fr.B: La parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} adressa au prophète Jérémie au sujet de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, qui allait venir attaquer le pays d’Égypte :
fr.R: Voici le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné au prophète Jérémie au sujet du moment où Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, viendrait attaquer l’Égypte :

sw.L: Neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Yeremia nabii juu ya kuja kwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli kuipiga nchi ya Misri:
sw.B: Neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia nabii Yeremia kuhusu Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli kuja kuishambulia nchi ya Misri:
sw.R: Huu ndio ujumbe ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa nabii Yeremia kuhusu wakati ambapo Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli angekuja kuishambulia Misri:

vi.L: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi về việc Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn sẽ đến đánh xứ Ai Cập:
vi.B: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi về việc Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đến tấn công xứ Ai Cập:
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi về lúc Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn sẽ đến tấn công Ai Cập:

ko.L: 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살이 와서 이집트 땅을 칠 일에 관하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예레미야에게 하신 말씀이다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살이 이집트 땅을 치러 올 일에 관하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예레미야에게 하신 말씀이다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살이 이집트를 치러 올 때에 관하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예레미야에게 주신 말씀은 이러하다.

pt.L: A palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a Jeremias, o profeta, sobre a vinda de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, para ferir a terra do Egito:
pt.B: A palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou ao profeta Jeremias sobre a vinda de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, para atacar a terra do Egito:
pt.R: Esta é a mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu ao profeta Jeremias sobre o tempo em que Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, viria atacar o Egito:

am.L: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የግብፅን ምድር ሊመታ ስለ መምጣቱ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለነቢዩ ለኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል፦
am.B: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የግብፅን ምድር ሊወጋ ስለሚመጣበት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለነቢዩ ለኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል፦
am.R: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር መጥቶ ግብፅን ስለሚወጋበት ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለነቢዩ ለኤርምያስ የሰጠው መልእክት ይህ ነው፦

hi.L: वह वचन जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह से बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के मिस्र देश को मारने के लिए आने के विषय में कहा:
hi.B: वह वचन जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह से बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के मिस्र देश पर हमला करने आने के बारे में कहा:
hi.R: यह वह संदेश है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने नबी यिर्मयाह को उस समय के बारे में दिया जब बाबुल का राजा नबूकदरेस्सर आकर मिस्र पर हमला करनेवाला था:

ru.L: Слово, которое изрёк {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Иеремии, пророку, о приходе Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона, чтобы поразить землю Египта:
ru.B: Слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал пророку Иеремии о том, что Навуходорносор, царь Вавилона, придёт напасть на землю Египта:
ru.R: Вот слово, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал пророку Иеремии о времени, когда Навуходорносор, царь Вавилона, придёт и нападёт на Египет:

uk.L: Слово, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} говорив пророкові Єремії про прихід Навуходоносора, царя Вавилону, щоб уразити землю Єгипту:
uk.B: Слово, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав пророкові Єремії про те, що Навуходоносор, цар Вавилону, прийде напасти на єгипетську землю:
uk.R: Ось послання, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав пророкові Єремії про час, коли Навуходоносор, цар Вавилону, прийде й нападе на Єгипет:

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar's coming to strike Egypt: an attack on Egypt itself, after Carchemish
decisions.reason: The first poem (verses 3-12) is about the battle far away on the Euphrates; this second one (verses 14-24) is about the enemy coming into Egypt. Jeremiah had already acted out such an attack at Tahpanhes (43:8-13). A broken Babylonian chronicle tablet is usually taken to record a campaign of Nebuchadrezzar against Egypt in his thirty-seventh year, about 568 BC; this is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: a new heading
decisions.reason: The heading has a different form from verse 1 ("the word that the LORD spoke", compare 50:1). It marks the start of a second oracle about Egypt. The name has the form Nebuchadrezzar, as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: about the time when ... would come and attack
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the message looks ahead to an attack still to come.

decisions.choice: "Навуходорносор"
decisions.reason: The spelling with r, as the Hebrew has it in this heading.

source.text: הַגִּ֤ידוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְהַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ בְמִגְדּ֔וֹל וְהַשְׁמִ֥יעוּ בְנֹ֖ף וּבְתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס אִמְר֗וּ הִתְיַצֵּב֙ וְהָכֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־אָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב סְבִיבֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol, and proclaim in Noph and in Tahpanhes; say: Take your stand and prepare yourself, for has devoured [the] sword [those] around you.

en.L: Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; \q proclaim in Memphis and in Tahpanhes. \q Say, "Take your stand and get yourself ready, \q for the sword has devoured those around you."
en.B: Announce it in Egypt, proclaim it in Migdol, \q proclaim it in Memphis and in Tahpanhes. \q Say, "Take your position and make ready, \q for the sword is devouring all around you."
en.R: Announce this in Egypt. Spread the news in the towns of Migdol, Memphis and Tahpanhes. \q Tell them, "Get into position and be ready to fight! \q War is destroying everyone around you."

es.L: {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} en Egipto, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} oír en Migdol; \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} oír en Menfis y en Tafnes. \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: «¡Ponte en pie y prepárate, \q porque la espada devora a los que están a tu alrededor!».
es.B: {{plural_you:Anúncienlo|Anunciadlo}} en Egipto, {{plural_you:proclámenlo|proclamadlo}} en Migdol, \q {{plural_you:proclámenlo|proclamadlo}} en Menfis y en Tafnes. \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: «¡Toma tu puesto y prepárate, \q porque la espada está devorando todo a tu alrededor!».
es.R: {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} esto en Egipto. {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} la noticia en las ciudades de Migdol, Menfis y Tafnes. \q {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}}: «¡{{plural_you:Ocupen sus puestos|Ocupad vuestros puestos}} y {{plural_you:prepárense|preparaos}} para pelear! \q La guerra está destruyendo a todos los que están a {{plural_you:su alrededor|vuestro alrededor}}».

fr.L: Annoncez en Égypte, et faites entendre à Migdol ; \q faites entendre à Memphis et à Tahpanhès. \q Dites : « Tiens-toi prêt et prépare-toi, \q car l’épée a dévoré ce qui t’entoure. »
fr.B: Annoncez-le en Égypte, proclamez-le à Migdol, \q proclamez-le à Memphis et à Tahpanhès. \q Dites : « Prends position et tiens-toi prêt, \q car l’épée dévore tout autour de toi. »
fr.R: Annoncez-le en Égypte. Répandez la nouvelle dans les villes de Migdol, de Memphis et de Tahpanhès. \q Dites-leur : « Mettez-vous en position et préparez-vous au combat ! \q La guerre détruit tout le monde autour de vous. »

sw.L: Tangazeni katika Misri, mkahubiri katika Migdoli; \q hubirini katika Memfisi na katika Tahpanhesi. \q Semeni, "Simama imara, ujiweke tayari, \q kwa maana upanga umewala walio kando yako."
sw.B: Litangazeni katika Misri, lihubirini katika Migdoli, \q lihubirini katika Memfisi na katika Tahpanhesi. \q Semeni, "Shika nafasi yako, ujiandae, \q kwa maana upanga unakula pande zote zako."
sw.R: Tangazeni jambo hili katika Misri. Pelekeni habari katika miji ya Migdoli, Memfisi na Tahpanhesi. \q Waambieni, "Shikeni nafasi zenu, mjiandae kupigana! \q Vita vinaangamiza kila mtu aliye karibu nanyi."

vi.L: Hãy rao báo trong Ai Cập, hãy loan tin tại Mích-đôn; \q hãy loan tin tại Mem-phít và tại Tác-pha-nết. \q Hãy nói: "Hãy đứng vào hàng ngũ và chuẩn bị, \q vì gươm đã nuốt những kẻ chung quanh ngươi."
vi.B: Hãy công bố trong Ai Cập, hãy loan báo tại Mích-đôn, \q hãy loan báo tại Mem-phít và tại Tác-pha-nết. \q Hãy nói: "Hãy vào vị trí và sẵn sàng, \q vì gươm đang tàn phá chung quanh ngươi."
vi.R: Hãy loan báo điều này tại Ai Cập. Hãy truyền tin ra các thành Mích-đôn, Mem-phít và Tác-pha-nết. \q Hãy bảo họ: "Hãy vào vị trí và sẵn sàng chiến đấu! \q Chiến tranh đang tàn phá mọi người chung quanh ngươi."

ko.L: 이집트에 알리고, 믹돌에 선포하여라. \q 멤피스와 다바네스에 선포하여라. \q 말하여라. "자리를 잡고 너 자신을 준비하여라. \q 칼이 네 주위를 삼켰다."
ko.B: 이집트에 알리고, 믹돌에 선포하여라. \q 멤피스와 다바네스에 선포하여라. \q 이렇게 말하여라. "제자리를 지키고 준비하여라. \q 칼이 네 주위를 삼키고 있다."
ko.R: 이집트에 알려라. 믹돌과 멤피스와 다바네스 성읍에 소식을 퍼뜨려라. \q 이렇게 말하여라. "제자리를 지키고 싸울 준비를 하여라! \q 전쟁이 네 주위의 모든 사람을 멸망시키고 있다."

pt.L: Anunciem no Egito, e proclamem em Migdol; \q proclamem em Mênfis e em Tafnes. \q Digam: "Toma posição e prepara-te, \q pois a espada devorou os que estão ao teu redor."
pt.B: Anunciem isto no Egito, proclamem em Migdol, \q proclamem em Mênfis e em Tafnes. \q Digam: "Toma posição e prepara-te, \q pois a espada está devorando tudo ao teu redor."
pt.R: Anunciem isto no Egito. Espalhem a notícia nas cidades de Migdol, Mênfis e Tafnes. \q Digam: "Toma posição e prepara-te para lutar! \q A guerra está destruindo todos ao teu redor."

am.L: በግብፅ ተናገሩ፤ በሚግዶልም አውሩ፤ \q በሜምፊስና በጣፍኔስ አውሩ፤ \q እንዲህም በሉ፦ «ቁም፤ ራስህንም አዘጋጅ፤ \q ሰይፍ በዙሪያህ ያሉትን በልቷልና።»
am.B: በግብፅ አስታውቁ፤ በሚግዶል አውጁ፤ \q በሜምፊስና በጣፍኔስ አውጁ። \q እንዲህም በሉ፦ «በስፍራህ ቁም፤ ተዘጋጅም፤ \q ሰይፍ በዙሪያህ ያሉትን ሁሉ እየበላ ነውና።»
am.R: ይህን በግብፅ አስታውቁ። በሚግዶል፣ በሜምፊስና በጣፍኔስ ከተሞች ወሬውን አሰራጩ። \q እንዲህም በሏቸው፦ «በስፍራችሁ ቁሙ፤ ለመዋጋትም ተዘጋጁ! \q ጦርነት በዙሪያችሁ ያሉትን ሁሉ እያጠፋ ነው።»

hi.L: मिस्र में बताओ, और मिग्दोल में सुनाओ; \q मेम्फ़िस और तहपन्हेस में सुनाओ। \q कहो, "खड़े हो जाओ और अपने आप को तैयार करो, \q क्योंकि तलवार ने तुम्हारे चारों ओर के [लोगों] को खा लिया है।"
hi.B: मिस्र में इसकी घोषणा करो, मिग्दोल में सुनाओ, \q मेम्फ़िस और तहपन्हेस में सुनाओ। \q कहो, "अपने-अपने स्थान पर डटकर तैयार हो जाओ, \q क्योंकि तलवार तुम्हारे चारों ओर सब कुछ खा रही है।"
hi.R: मिस्र में यह घोषणा करो। मिग्दोल, मेम्फ़िस और तहपन्हेस नगरों में यह ख़बर फैला दो। \q उनसे कहो, "मोर्चा सँभालो और लड़ने को तैयार हो जाओ! \q युद्ध तुम्हारे आस-पास के सब लोगों को नाश कर रहा है।"

ru.L: Возвестите в Египте и объявите в Мигдоле; \q объявите в Мемфисе и в Тафнисе. \q Скажите: «Стань и приготовься, \q потому что меч пожрал [всех] вокруг тебя.»
ru.B: Возвестите в Египте, объявите в Мигдоле, \q объявите в Мемфисе и в Тафнисе. \q Скажите: «Займи свою позицию и будь готов, \q потому что меч пожирает всё вокруг тебя.»
ru.R: Объявите это в Египте. Разнесите весть в городах Мигдоле, Мемфисе и Тафнисе. \q Скажите им: «Займите свои места и будьте готовы к бою! \q Война уничтожает всех вокруг вас.»

uk.L: Звістіть у Єгипті й оголосіть у Мигдолі; \q оголосіть у Мемфісі й у Тахпанхесі. \q Скажіть: «Ставай і готуйся, \q бо меч пожер тих, хто довкола тебе».
uk.B: Сповістіть це в Єгипті, оголосіть у Мигдолі, \q оголосіть у Мемфісі й у Тахпанхесі. \q Скажіть: «Ставай на місце й готуйся, \q бо меч пожирає все довкола тебе».
uk.R: Оголосіть це в Єгипті. Рознесіть звістку по містах Мигдол, Мемфіс і Тахпанхес. \q Скажіть їм: «Ставайте на місця й будьте готові до бою! \q Війна нищить усіх довкола вас».

decisions.choice: Migdol, Noph and Tahpanhes: cities of northern Egypt
decisions.reason: Migdol was a fortress on Egypt's north-eastern border and Tahpanhes a frontier city in the eastern delta; Noph is Memphis, the old capital near the head of the delta (2:16; Isaiah 19:13). Judeans who fled to Egypt had settled in all three (43:7; 44:1). An enemy from Asia would reach them first.

decisions.choice: the sword has devoured those around you: the neighbors have already fallen
decisions.reason: The verb is past: the sword has already eaten up Egypt's neighbors, and Egypt is next. The commands to take position are given to Egypt as a single soldier ("you" is singular).

decisions.choice: Memphis
decisions.reason: All levels use the familiar name Memphis for Noph, as in 2:16 and Isaiah 19:13.

decisions.choice: War is destroying
decisions.reason: Readable says "war" for the sword, as the book's set phrase does ("war, famine and disease").

decisions.choice: Menfis
decisions.reason: As in 44:1, *Noph* is Memphis at every level.

decisions.choice: "Memfisi" for *Noph* at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: the city is named by its familiar name.

decisions.choice: "멤피스" for *Noph*, as set at 44:1
decisions.reason: As the English.

decisions.choice: Noph is "ሜምፊስ", as the English and 44:1.
decisions.reason: One form of the city's name through chapters 44 and 46.

decisions.choice: "Мигдол", "Мемфис", "Тафнис"
decisions.reason: The towns as in 44:1 (m1); Readable says "война" for the sword, as in the Jeremiah list "war, famine and disease".

source.text: מַדּ֖וּעַ נִסְחַ֣ף אַבִּירֶ֑יךָ לֹ֣א עָמַ֔ד כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֲדָפֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why has been swept away your mighty one? Not he stood, for Yahweh thrust him down.

en.L: Why has your mighty one been swept away? \q He did not stand, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thrust him down.
en.B: Why is your mighty one swept away? \q He could not stand, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drove him down.
en.R: Egypt, why has your strong one been swept away? \q He could not stand his ground, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pushed him down.

es.L: ¿Por qué ha sido arrastrado tu poderoso? \q No se mantuvo en pie, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo derribó.
es.B: ¿Por qué ha sido arrastrado tu poderoso? \q No pudo mantenerse en pie, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo echó por tierra.
es.R: Egipto, ¿por qué ha sido arrastrado tu fuerte? \q No pudo mantenerse firme, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo derribó.

fr.L: Pourquoi ton puissant a-t-il été emporté ? \q Il n’a pas tenu bon, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a renversé.
fr.B: Pourquoi ton puissant est-il emporté ? \q Il n’a pas pu tenir, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a jeté à terre.
fr.R: Égypte, pourquoi ton champion a-t-il été emporté ? \q Il n’a pas pu tenir bon, \q parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a jeté à terre.

sw.L: Mbona shujaa wako amefagiliwa mbali? \q Hakusimama, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimsukuma chini.
sw.B: Kwa nini shujaa wako amefagiliwa mbali? \q Hakuweza kusimama, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwangusha.
sw.R: Ewe Misri, kwa nini mwenye nguvu wako amefagiliwa mbali? \q Hakuweza kusimama imara, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimsukuma chini.

vi.L: Sao kẻ mạnh của ngươi bị cuốn đi? \q Nó không đứng vững được, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xô nó ngã.
vi.B: Sao kẻ mạnh của ngươi bị cuốn đi? \q Nó không thể đứng vững, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đẩy nó ngã.
vi.R: Hỡi Ai Cập, sao kẻ mạnh của ngươi bị cuốn đi? \q Nó không thể đứng vững, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xô nó ngã.

ko.L: 어찌하여 너의 강한 자가 쓸려 갔느냐? \q 그가 서지 못했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 밀어 넘어뜨리셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 어찌하여 너의 강한 자가 쓸려 가 버렸느냐? \q 그는 버티지 못했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 쓰러뜨리셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이집트야, 어찌하여 너의 힘센 자가 쓸려 갔느냐? \q 그는 제자리에 버티고 서지 못했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 밀어 쓰러뜨리셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: Por que foi arrastado o teu poderoso? \q Ele não ficou de pé, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o derrubou.
pt.B: Por que o teu poderoso foi arrastado? \q Ele não conseguiu ficar de pé, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o derrubou.
pt.R: Egito, por que o teu forte foi arrastado? \q Ele não conseguiu resistir, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o empurrou para o chão.

am.L: ኃያልህ ስለ ምን ተጠረገ? \q አልቆመም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ገፍትሮ ጥሎታልና።
am.B: ኃያልህ ለምን ተጠርጎ ተወሰደ? \q ሊቆም አልቻለም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ገፍትሮ ጥሎታልና።
am.R: ግብፅ ሆይ፣ ብርቱህ ለምን ተጠርጎ ተወሰደ? \q ጸንቶ ሊቆም አልቻለም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ገፍትሮ ጥሎታልና።

hi.L: तुम्हारा बलवंत क्यों बहा दिया गया है? \q वह खड़ा न रहा, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे धकेलकर गिरा दिया।
hi.B: तुम्हारा बलवंत क्यों बह गया है? \q वह टिक न सका, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे धकेलकर गिरा दिया।
hi.R: हे मिस्र, तुम्हारा बलवान क्यों बह गया है? \q वह अपनी जगह टिक न सका, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे धक्का देकर गिरा दिया।

ru.L: Почему повержен твой сильный? \q Он не устоял, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} низверг его.
ru.B: Почему сметён твой сильный? \q Он не смог устоять, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сбросил его.
ru.R: Египет, почему твой сильный сметён? \q Он не смог устоять, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} столкнул его.

uk.L: Чому змито твого могутнього? \q Він не встояв, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} скинув його.
uk.B: Чому змито твого могутнього? \q Він не міг устояти, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} повалив його.
uk.R: Єгипте, чому змито твого сильного? \q Він не зміг устояти, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} штовхнув його додолу.

decisions.choice: why has your mighty one been swept away (Hebrew)
alternatives: Why has Apis fled? Your chosen calf did not stand
decisions.reason: The Greek translation reads the Hebrew letters differently, dividing the verb into two words: "Why has Apis fled? Your chosen calf did not stand." Apis was the sacred bull worshiped at Memphis (verse 14). If that reading is right, the verse mocks Egypt's bull-god, unable to stand before the LORD. The Hebrew, which is followed here, speaks of a "mighty one" without naming him. This is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: your mighty one: a strong man, a bull, or Egypt's champion
decisions.reason: The word means "strong one". It is used of warriors (Lamentations 1:15), of powerful bulls (Psalm 22:13; 50:13), and in a related form of God as "the Mighty One of Jacob". Here it may be Egypt's god (the bull Apis), its king, or its strongest troops. The Hebrew form is plural, "your mighty ones", but the verbs that follow are singular, and some Hebrew manuscripts have the singular; the singular is followed.

decisions.choice: the LORD thrust him down
decisions.reason: The rout has a cause beyond the enemy: the LORD himself pushed Egypt's champion over, as one pushes a man off his feet.

decisions.choice: Egypt, ... strong one ... stand his ground
decisions.reason: Readable names who is addressed and keeps the open word "strong one" (m2) so that it can mean a god, a king or a warrior.

decisions.choice: tu poderoso (L, B); tu fuerte (R)
decisions.reason: The word can mean "mighty one" or "bull", perhaps the bull-god Apis of Memphis (see the meaning decisions); each level follows the English "mighty one".

decisions.choice: "너의 강한 자" (L, B), "너의 힘센 자" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves the word open (a strong man, a bull, Egypt's champion); Korean keeps a word that fits all three.

decisions.choice: "твого могутнього" (L, B), "твого сильного" (R), singular, as the English
decisions.reason: The English reads the singular of the Hebrew and leaves the identity open, so Ukrainian does not name the Apis bull.

decisions.choice: तुम्हारा बलवंत
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "your mighty one" may also be read as "your bull", the Apis bull of Egypt; the Hindi keeps "mighty one", as the English, without choosing.

decisions.choice: "твой сильный"
decisions.reason: The word may mean a strong man, a bull or Egypt's champion (m2); "сильный" leaves it as open as the Hebrew and the English do.

source.text: הִרְבָּ֖ה כּוֹשֵׁ֑ל גַּם־נָפַ֞ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ ק֣וּמָה׀וְנָשֻׁ֣בָה אֶל־עַמֵּ֗נוּ וְאֶל־אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַיּוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: He has multiplied [the] stumbler; also he has fallen, each to his neighbor, and they said: Arise, and let us return to our people and to [the] land of our birth, from before [the] sword of the oppressor.

en.L: He made many stumble; \q indeed, they fell, each against his neighbor, and they said, "Get up, and let us go back to our own people and to the land of our birth, \q away from the oppressor's sword!"
en.B: He made many stumble; \q they fell over one another. And they said, "Up! Let us go back to our own people and to the land where we were born, \q away from the oppressor's sword!"
en.R: He made many soldiers trip. \q They fell over one another. They said, "Get up! Let us go home to our own people, to the land where we were born, \q to get away from the enemy's cruel sword!"

es.L: Hizo tropezar a muchos; \q cayeron, cada uno sobre su compañero, y dijeron: «Levantémonos y volvamos a nuestro pueblo y a la tierra donde nacimos, \q lejos de la espada del opresor».
es.B: Hizo tropezar a muchos; \q cayeron unos sobre otros. Y dijeron: «¡Arriba! Volvamos a nuestro pueblo y a la tierra donde nacimos, \q lejos de la espada del opresor».
es.R: Hizo tropezar a muchos soldados. \q Cayeron unos sobre otros. Decían: «¡Levantémonos! Volvamos a casa, a nuestro pueblo, a la tierra donde nacimos, \q para escapar de la espada cruel del enemigo».

fr.L: Il a multiplié ceux qui trébuchent ; \q oui, ils sont tombés l’un sur l’autre, et ils ont dit : « Levez-vous, et retournons vers notre peuple et vers le pays de notre naissance, \q loin de l’épée de l’oppresseur ! »
fr.B: Il en a fait trébucher beaucoup ; \q ils sont tombés les uns sur les autres. Et ils ont dit : « Debout ! Retournons vers notre peuple, au pays où nous sommes nés, \q loin de l’épée de l’oppresseur ! »
fr.R: Il a fait trébucher beaucoup de soldats. \q Ils sont tombés les uns sur les autres. Ils ont dit : « Debout ! Rentrons chez nous, vers notre peuple, au pays où nous sommes nés, \q pour échapper à l’épée cruelle de l’ennemi ! »

sw.L: Aliwafanya wengi kujikwaa; \q naam, walianguka, kila mtu juu ya mwenzake, wakasema, "Inukeni, turudi kwa watu wetu na katika nchi tuliyozaliwa, \q mbali na upanga wa mdhalimu!"
sw.B: Aliwafanya wengi kujikwaa; \q wakaangukiana. Wakasema, "Inukeni! Turudi kwa watu wetu na katika nchi tuliyozaliwa, \q mbali na upanga wa mdhalimu!"
sw.R: Aliwafanya askari wengi kujikwaa. \q Wakaangukiana. Wakasema, "Inukeni! Twende nyumbani kwa watu wetu, katika nchi tuliyozaliwa, \q tuukimbie upanga wa adui mkatili!"

vi.L: Ngài làm cho nhiều kẻ vấp ngã; \q phải, chúng ngã, người này đè lên người kia, và chúng nói: "Hãy đứng dậy, chúng ta hãy trở về với dân mình và về xứ nơi chúng ta sinh ra, \q tránh xa lưỡi gươm của kẻ áp bức!"
vi.B: Ngài làm cho nhiều kẻ vấp ngã; \q chúng ngã đè lên nhau. Chúng nói: "Dậy đi! Chúng ta hãy trở về với dân mình, về quê hương nơi chúng ta sinh ra, \q tránh xa lưỡi gươm của kẻ áp bức!"
vi.R: Ngài làm cho nhiều quân lính vấp ngã. \q Chúng ngã đè lên nhau. Chúng nói: "Dậy đi! Chúng ta hãy về nhà, về với dân mình, về quê hương nơi chúng ta sinh ra, \q để tránh xa lưỡi gươm tàn bạo của quân thù!"

ko.L: 그분께서 넘어지는 자를 많게 하셨다. \q 참으로 그들이 서로 엎어지며 말했다. "일어나라, 우리 백성에게로, 우리가 태어난 땅으로 돌아가자. \q 압제자의 칼을 피하자!"
ko.B: 그분께서 많은 사람을 넘어지게 하셨다. \q 그들은 서로 엎어지며 말했다. "일어나라! 우리 백성에게로, 우리가 태어난 땅으로 돌아가자. \q 압제자의 칼을 피하자!"
ko.R: 그분께서 많은 군인을 넘어지게 하셨다. \q 그들은 서로 엎어졌다. 그들은 말했다. "일어나라! 우리 백성에게로, 우리가 태어난 고향 땅으로 돌아가자. \q 원수의 무서운 칼을 피하자!"

pt.L: Ele fez muitos tropeçarem; \q sim, caíram, cada um sobre o seu companheiro, e disseram: "Levantem-se, e voltemos ao nosso povo e à terra do nosso nascimento, \q para longe da espada do opressor!"
pt.B: Ele fez muitos tropeçarem; \q caíram uns sobre os outros. E disseram: "De pé! Voltemos para o nosso povo e para a terra onde nascemos, \q para longe da espada do opressor!"
pt.R: Ele fez muitos soldados tropeçarem. \q Eles caíram uns sobre os outros. Disseram: "Levantem-se! Vamos voltar para o nosso povo, para a terra onde nascemos, \q para fugir da espada cruel do inimigo!"

am.L: የሚሰናከሉትን አበዛ፤ \q እያንዳንዱም በባልንጀራው ላይ ወደቀ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ተነሡ፤ ወደ ወገኖቻችንና ወደ ተወለድንበት ምድር እንመለስ፤ \q ከአስጨናቂው ሰይፍ ፊት [እንሽሽ]!»
am.B: ብዙዎችን አሰናከለ፤ \q እርስ በርሳቸው ተደራርበው ወደቁ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ተነሡ! ወደ ወገኖቻችንና ወደ ተወለድንበት ምድር እንመለስ፤ \q ከአስጨናቂው ሰይፍ እንራቅ!»
am.R: ብዙ ወታደሮችን አሰናከለ። \q እርስ በርሳቸው ተደራርበው ወደቁ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ተነሡ! ወደ ወገኖቻችን፣ ወደ ተወለድንበት ምድር ወደ ቤታችን እንሂድ፤ \q ከጨካኙ ጠላት ሰይፍ እናምልጥ!»

hi.L: उसने बहुतों को ठोकर खिलाई; \q हाँ, वे एक-दूसरे पर गिर पड़े, और उन्होंने कहा, "उठो, हम अपने लोगों के पास और अपनी जन्मभूमि को लौट चलें, \q अत्याचारी की तलवार के सामने से!"
hi.B: उसने बहुतों को ठोकर खिलाई; \q वे एक-दूसरे पर गिर पड़े। और उन्होंने कहा, "उठो! हम अपने लोगों के पास और अपनी जन्मभूमि को लौट चलें, \q अत्याचारी की तलवार से दूर!"
hi.R: उसने बहुत-से सैनिकों को ठोकर खिलाई। \q वे एक-दूसरे पर गिर पड़े। उन्होंने कहा, "उठो! हम अपने लोगों के पास, अपनी जन्मभूमि को लौट चलें, \q ताकि शत्रु की निर्दयी तलवार से बच सकें!"

ru.L: Он умножил спотыкающихся; \q и пали они друг на друга, и сказали: «Вставайте, и вернёмся к нашему народу и в землю нашего рождения \q от меча притеснителя!»
ru.B: Он заставил многих споткнуться; \q они падали друг на друга. И они сказали: «Вставайте! Вернёмся к своему народу, в землю, где мы родились, \q прочь от меча притеснителя!»
ru.R: Он заставил многих воинов споткнуться. \q Они падали друг на друга. Они говорили: «Вставайте! Пойдём домой, к своему народу, в землю, где мы родились, \q чтобы спастись от жестокого меча врага!»

uk.L: Він змусив багатьох спіткнутися; \q і вони впали, кожен на свого ближнього, і сказали: «Вставайте, і вернімося до свого народу і до землі нашого народження, \q від меча гнобителя!»
uk.B: Він змусив багатьох спіткнутися; \q вони падали один на одного. І вони сказали: «Вставаймо! Вернімося до свого народу і до землі, де ми народилися, \q подалі від меча гнобителя!»
uk.R: Він змусив багатьох воїнів спіткнутися. \q Вони падали один на одного. Вони казали: «Вставайте! Ходімо додому, до свого народу, до землі, де ми народилися, \q щоб утекти від жорстокого меча ворога!»

decisions.choice: he multiplied the stumbler: he made many stumble
decisions.reason: The verb "make many" has the LORD of verse 15 as its subject, and "the one stumbling" stands for every soldier who trips. The stumbling of verses 6 and 12 spreads through the army.

decisions.choice: let us go back to our own people: the foreign soldiers give up
decisions.reason: Those who speak have a people and a homeland elsewhere. They are most likely the hired troops of verses 9 and 21, who leave Egypt to its fate (compare the same words in 50:16, of foreigners in Babylon).

decisions.choice: the oppressor's sword: the sword of the cruel enemy
decisions.reason: The word is a participle, "oppressing", from a verb used of treating people with violence (22:3). The same phrase is used in 50:16 and, of the destroyer, in 25:38. It has the same letters as the word for "dove", but "oppressor" fits every place it is used.

decisions.choice: soldiers; the enemy's cruel sword
decisions.reason: Readable supplies who stumbles and says who the oppressor is.

decisions.choice: Ngài (He made many stumble)
decisions.reason: The subject is the LORD of verse 15, so Vietnamese says "Ngài", the pronoun for God, where the English has a plain "He".

decisions.choice: a espada do opressor
decisions.reason: The phrase (m3) is worded so that 50:16, where it returns, can repeat it.

source.text: קָרְא֖וּ שָׁ֑ם פַּרְעֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ שָׁא֔וֹן הֶעֱבִ֖יר הַמּוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: They called there: Pharaoh king of Egypt [is] a noise; he has let pass the appointed time.

en.L: They called out there, \q "Pharaoh king of Egypt [is but] a noise; \q he has let the appointed time pass by."
en.B: There they cried out, \q "Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; \q he has let his moment pass."
en.R: There they say, \q "Pharaoh king of Egypt is just a lot of noise. \q He missed his chance."

es.L: Allí gritaron: \q «El faraón, rey de Egipto, [no es más que] ruido; \q dejó pasar el tiempo señalado».
es.B: Allí gritaban: \q «El faraón, rey de Egipto, no es más que mucho ruido; \q dejó pasar su oportunidad».
es.R: Allí dicen: \q «El faraón, rey de Egipto, no es más que puro ruido. \q Perdió su oportunidad».

fr.L: Ils ont crié là : \q « Le pharaon, roi d’Égypte, [n’est qu’]un bruit ; \q il a laissé passer le moment fixé. »
fr.B: Là, ils ont crié : \q « Le pharaon, roi d’Égypte, n’est qu’un grand bruit ; \q il a laissé passer son heure. »
fr.R: Là-bas, ils disent : \q « Le pharaon, roi d’Égypte, ne fait que du bruit. \q Il a laissé passer sa chance. »

sw.L: Walipiga kelele huko, \q "Farao mfalme wa Misri [ni] kelele tu; \q ameuacha wakati ulioamriwa upite."
sw.B: Huko walilia, \q "Farao mfalme wa Misri ni kelele kubwa tu; \q ameiacha nafasi yake ipite."
sw.R: Huko wanasema, \q "Farao mfalme wa Misri ni kelele nyingi tu. \q Ameikosa nafasi yake."

vi.L: Ở đó chúng kêu lên: \q "Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập [chỉ là] một tiếng ồn ào; \q hắn đã để lỡ thời điểm đã định."
vi.B: Ở đó chúng kêu lên: \q "Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập chỉ là tiếng ồn ào; \q hắn đã để lỡ thời cơ."
vi.R: Ở đó chúng nói: \q "Pha-ra-ôn vua Ai Cập chỉ to tiếng mà thôi. \q Hắn đã bỏ lỡ cơ hội."

ko.L: 그들이 거기서 외쳤다. \q "이집트 왕 바로는 [한낱] 소음일 뿐, \q 정해진 때를 그냥 지나가게 했다."
ko.B: 그들이 거기서 외쳤다. \q "이집트 왕 바로는 시끄러운 소리일 뿐이다. \q 그는 자기 때를 놓쳐 버렸다."
ko.R: 그들은 거기서 이렇게 말한다. \q "이집트 왕 바로는 그저 큰소리만 친다. \q 그는 기회를 놓쳐 버렸다."

pt.L: Ali clamaram: \q "Faraó, rei do Egito, [não passa de] um barulho; \q ele deixou passar o tempo marcado."
pt.B: Ali gritaram: \q "Faraó, rei do Egito, é só um grande barulho; \q ele deixou passar a sua hora."
pt.R: Ali eles dizem: \q "Faraó, rei do Egito, é só barulho. \q Ele perdeu a sua chance."

am.L: በዚያ እንዲህ ብለው ጮኹ፦ \q «የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ጩኸት [ብቻ ነው]፤ \q የተወሰነውን ጊዜ አሳልፏል።»
am.B: በዚያ እንዲህ ብለው ጮኹ፦ \q «የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ባዶ ጩኸት ብቻ ነው፤ \q ጊዜው እንዲያልፍበት ፈቀደ።»
am.R: በዚያ እንዲህ ይላሉ፦ \q «የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ጩኸት ብቻ ነው። \q ዕድሉን አመለጠው።»

hi.L: उन्होंने वहाँ पुकारा, \q "मिस्र का राजा फ़िरौन [बस] एक शोर [है]; \q उसने ठहराए हुए समय को निकल जाने दिया।"
hi.B: वहाँ उन्होंने पुकारकर कहा, \q "मिस्र का राजा फ़िरौन बस एक ऊँचा शोर है; \q उसने अपना अवसर हाथ से जाने दिया।"
hi.R: वहाँ वे कहते हैं, \q "मिस्र का राजा फ़िरौन बस शोर ही शोर है। \q उसने अपना मौक़ा गँवा दिया।"

ru.L: Кричали там: \q «Фараон, царь Египта, — [лишь] шум; \q он пропустил назначенное время.»
ru.B: Там они кричали: \q «Фараон, царь Египта, — всего лишь громкий шум; \q он упустил свой час.»
ru.R: Там говорят: \q «Фараон, царь Египта, — это просто много шума. \q Он упустил свою возможность.»

uk.L: Вони закликали там: \q «Фараон, цар Єгипту, — [лише] гамір; \q він пропустив призначений час».
uk.B: Там вони кричали: \q «Фараон, цар Єгипту, — лише гучний галас; \q він проґавив свою мить».
uk.R: Там кажуть: \q «Фараон, цар Єгипту, — це тільки багато галасу. \q Він проґавив свій шанс».

decisions.choice: a noise who let the appointed time pass: a mocking nickname for Pharaoh
alternatives: They called Pharaoh king of Egypt 'Noise, who let the appointed time pass'
decisions.reason: "Called" can mean "gave a name", as in 20:3, and the words that follow sound like a nickname: "Loud Noise, who let the appointed time go by". Pharaoh made a great din of threats and promises but missed his moment to act, as Isaiah called Egypt "Rahab who sits still" (Isaiah 30:7). The Greek translation reads "call the name of Pharaoh Neco", treating the words as a name; this is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: noise: the roar of a crowd or an army, a loud din
decisions.reason: The word is used of the roar of armies and of rushing waters (25:31; 48:45; Isaiah 17:12-13). Egypt, which rose roaring like the Nile (verses 7-8), turns out to be only sound.

decisions.choice: they called there: the soldiers who flee
decisions.reason: "They" are most likely the soldiers of verse 16, who shout this as they leave; "there" is the place of the defeat.

decisions.choice: [is but] a noise (Literal); only a loud noise (Balanced); just a lot of noise (Readable); let his moment pass / missed his chance
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the words as a saying about Pharaoh and gives "let the appointed time pass" in plain English at Balanced and Readable. The footnote gives the reading as a nickname (m1).

decisions.choice: "[лишь] шум" (L); "всего лишь громкий шум" (B); "просто много шума" (R)
decisions.reason: A mocking name for Pharaoh (m1): a loud din and nothing more, a king who let his moment pass.

source.text: חַי־אָ֨נִי֙ נְאֻם־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ כִּ֚י כְּתָב֣וֹר בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּכְכַרְמֶ֖ל בַּיָּ֥ם יָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: [As] I live, declares the King, Yahweh of hosts [is] his name, surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, he will come.

en.L: As I live, declares the King, \q whose name [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q surely like Tabor among the mountains \q and like Carmel by the sea, he will come.
en.B: As I live, declares the King, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, \q one is coming who is like Tabor among the mountains, \q like Carmel by the sea.
en.R: As surely as I live, says the King, \q whose name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q someone is coming who towers like Mount Tabor over the mountains \q and like Mount Carmel over the sea.

es.L: Vivo yo, declara el Rey, \q cuyo nombre [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q que como el Tabor entre los montes \q y como el Carmelo junto al mar, vendrá.
es.B: Vivo yo, afirma el Rey, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, \q que vendrá uno que es como el Tabor entre los montes, \q como el Carmelo junto al mar.
es.R: Tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice el Rey, \q cuyo nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q viene alguien que se eleva como el monte Tabor sobre los montes \q y como el monte Carmelo sobre el mar.

fr.L: Je suis vivant, déclare le Roi, \q dont le nom [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q oui, comme le Thabor parmi les montagnes \q et comme le Carmel près de la mer, il viendra.
fr.B: Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare le Roi, \q dont le nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q quelqu’un vient, semblable au Thabor parmi les montagnes, \q semblable au Carmel près de la mer.
fr.R: Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, dit le Roi, \q dont le nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q quelqu’un vient qui domine tout, comme le mont Thabor domine les montagnes \q et comme le mont Carmel domine la mer.

sw.L: Kama niishivyo, asema Mfalme, \q ambaye jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q hakika kama Tabori katikati ya milima, \q na kama Karmeli kando ya bahari, atakuja.
sw.B: Kama niishivyo, asema Mfalme, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q anakuja mmoja aliye kama Tabori katikati ya milima, \q kama Karmeli kando ya bahari.
sw.R: Kama niishivyo hakika, anasema Mfalme, \q ambaye jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q anakuja mtu aliye juu kama mlima Tabori juu ya milima mingine, \q na kama mlima Karmeli juu ya bahari.

vi.L: Ta hằng sống, Vua phán vậy, \q danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, \q chắc chắn như núi Tha-bô giữa các núi \q và như Cạt-mên bên biển, nó sẽ đến.
vi.B: Ta hằng sống, Vua phán vậy, \q danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân: \q có một kẻ sẽ đến, như núi Tha-bô giữa các núi, \q như Cạt-mên bên biển.
vi.R: Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Vua phán, \q là Đấng có danh là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, \q có một kẻ sẽ đến, sừng sững như núi Tha-bô vượt trên các núi \q và như núi Cạt-mên nhô cao trên biển.

ko.L: 내가 살아 있음을 두고 [맹세한다]. 왕의 선언이다. \q 그의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. \q 산들 가운데 다볼 같고, \q 바닷가의 갈멜 같은 자가 반드시 올 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 왕이 말한다. \q 그의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. \q 산들 가운데 우뚝 솟은 다볼 산 같고, \q 바닷가의 갈멜 산 같은 자가 오고 있다.
ko.R: 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 왕이 말한다. \q 그 왕의 이름은 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. \q 다볼 산이 산들 위로 우뚝 솟은 것처럼, \q 갈멜 산이 바다 위로 솟은 것처럼 높은 자가 오고 있다.

pt.L: [Tão certo como] eu vivo, declara o Rei, \q cujo nome [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q certamente como o Tabor entre os montes \q e como o Carmelo junto ao mar, ele virá.
pt.B: Tão certo como eu vivo, declara o Rei, \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, \q vem alguém que é como o Tabor entre os montes, \q como o Carmelo junto ao mar.
pt.R: Tão certo como eu vivo, diz o Rei, \q cujo nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q está vindo alguém que se ergue como o monte Tabor acima dos montes \q e como o monte Carmelo acima do mar.

am.L: ስሙ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት የሆነው ንጉሥ፦ \q እኔ ሕያው ነኝ፣ ይላል፤ \q በተራሮች መካከል እንዳለው እንደ ታቦር፣ \q በባሕርም አጠገብ እንዳለው እንደ ቀርሜሎስ በእርግጥ ይመጣል።
am.B: እኔ ሕያው ነኝ፣ ይላል ንጉሡ፤ \q ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው፤ \q በተራሮች መካከል እንዳለው እንደ ታቦር፣ \q በባሕር አጠገብ እንዳለው እንደ ቀርሜሎስ የሆነ ይመጣል።
am.R: እኔ ሕያው እንደ ሆንኩ በእርግጥ፣ ይላል ንጉሡ፤ \q ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሆነው፤ \q ታቦር ተራራ ከተራሮች በላይ ከፍ እንደሚል \q ቀርሜሎስ ተራራም ከባሕሩ በላይ ከፍ እንደሚል ከፍ ያለ አንድ ሰው ይመጣል።

hi.L: मेरे जीवन की शपथ, उस राजा की यह वाणी है \q जिनका नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [है], \q निश्चय वह पहाड़ों के बीच ताबोर के समान \q और समुद्र के किनारे कर्मेल के समान आएगा।
hi.B: मेरे जीवन की शपथ, उस राजा की यह वाणी है, \q जिनका नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है, \q एक आ रहा है जो पहाड़ों के बीच ताबोर के समान है, \q समुद्र के किनारे कर्मेल के समान।
hi.R: मेरे जीवन की शपथ, वह राजा कहते हैं \q जिनका नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है, \q कोई आ रहा है जो ऐसा ऊँचा है जैसे पहाड़ों के बीच ताबोर पहाड़ \q और समुद्र के ऊपर कर्मेल पहाड़।

ru.L: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — слово Царя, \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя, — \q что, как Фавор среди гор \q и как Кармил у моря, придёт он.
ru.B: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — говорит Царь, \q чьё имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — \q придёт тот, кто подобен Фавору среди гор, \q подобен Кармилу у моря.
ru.R: Как верно то, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} жив, — говорит Царь, \q чьё имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, — \q придёт тот, кто возвышается, как гора Фавор над горами \q и как гора Кармил над морем.

uk.L: Як живий {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, говорить Цар, \q чиє імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, \q справді, як Тавор між горами \q і як Кармел над морем, він прийде.
uk.B: Як живий {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, говорить Цар, \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ — {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя, \q прийде той, хто подібний до Тавору між горами, \q до Кармелу над морем.
uk.R: Як живий {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, каже Цар, \q чиє імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, \q прийде хтось, хто височітиме, як гора Тавор над горами \q і як гора Кармел над морем.

decisions.choice: as I live: an oath
decisions.reason: God swears by his own life, the most solemn oath there is (22:24; Numbers 14:21; Isaiah 49:18). What follows is certain.

decisions.choice: Tabor and Carmel: mountains that stand out above everything around them
decisions.reason: Mount Tabor rises alone out of the plain of Jezreel, and the ridge of Carmel stands high above the Mediterranean coast. The one who is coming stands out above every power in the same way.

decisions.choice: he will come: the conqueror, unnamed here
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. The heading (verse 13) shows that it is Nebuchadrezzar, the one "coming" against Egypt; verses 20 and 24 speak of him as coming from the north.

decisions.choice: the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts
decisions.reason: Pharaoh is "king of Egypt" (verse 17), but the true King is the LORD (10:7, 10). The same title returns in 48:15 and 51:57.

decisions.choice: one is coming (Balanced); someone is coming who towers ... Mount (Readable); As surely as I live (Readable); the LORD of Armies is his name (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Readable words the oath "As surely as I live", the usual English form of this oath, and Balanced keeps the Hebrew order of the title, "the LORD of Armies is his name". Both also supply a subject for "he will come" (m3), and Readable adds "Mount" and "towers" to show what the comparison means (m2).

decisions.choice: Vivo yo (L, B); Tan cierto como que yo vivo (R)
decisions.reason: God's own oath, in the wording set in the Samuel note.

decisions.choice: danh Ngài (the King's name)
decisions.reason: The King speaks of his own name in the third person; Vietnamese keeps that, with the span on "Ngài". Tha-bô and Cạt-mên are the published forms.

decisions.choice: "왕의 선언이다" (L), "왕이 말한다" (B, R), and "그의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다", without "-시-"
decisions.reason: The King here is God naming himself inside his own oath, so he takes no honorific (terms note); in God's mouth Readable says "거느린".

decisions.choice: [Tão certo como] eu vivo (L); Tão certo como eu vivo (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's oath by his own life (m1) takes the shape 4:2 sets for the oath by the LORD's life, with brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: "As I live, declares the King" is "እኔ ሕያው ነኝ፣ ይላል ንጉሡ"; Tabor "ታቦር", Carmel "ቀርሜሎስ". Literal opens with the King's title so that "ይላል" can follow the oath, as the formula asks.
decisions.reason: The declares-formula keeps "ይላል" after the words; Readable names both as mountains, as its English.

decisions.choice: मेरे जीवन की शपथ; उस राजा की यह वाणी है (L, B), वह राजा कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: God's oath "as I live" as Isaiah 49:18 in Hindi; "declares the King" follows the neum formula with "the King" in place of the name. Tabor and Carmel as 1 Samuel 10:3 and 1 Chronicles 11:37.

decisions.choice: "— слово Царя, ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф — его имя" (L); "говорит Царь, чьё имя — ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф / Воинств" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 51:57 in this translation for this formula (m4); the oath "Жив я" (L, B) and "Как верно то, что я жив" (R) follows the oath wording of 16:14.

decisions.choice: "Фавор", "Кармил"
decisions.reason: The mountains in the forms of Judges, Samuel and Kings in this translation (m2).

source.text: כְּלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־נֹף֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְנִצְּתָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Baggage of exile make for yourself, dweller daughter of Egypt; for Noph will become a waste and be laid in ruins, without inhabitant.

en.L: Make yourself baggage for exile, \q you who dwell [there], daughter of Egypt! \q For Memphis will become a waste, \q and it will be laid in ruins, without inhabitant.
en.B: Pack your bags for exile, \q you people of Daughter Egypt! \q For Memphis will become a wasteland, \q a ruin where no one lives.
en.R: People of Egypt, \q pack your bags to be taken away as prisoners! \q The city of Memphis will become an empty ruin. \q No one will live there.

es.L: Hazte equipaje para el destierro, \q tú que habitas [allí], hija de Egipto; \q porque Menfis será una desolación, \q y quedará en ruinas, sin habitante.
es.B: Prepara tu equipaje para el destierro, \q pueblo de la hija de Egipto; \q porque Menfis quedará desolada, \q en ruinas, sin que nadie viva en ella.
es.R: Pueblo de Egipto, \q prepara tus cosas, porque te llevarán prisionero. \q La ciudad de Menfis quedará en ruinas y vacía. \q Nadie vivirá allí.

fr.L: Fais-toi un bagage d’exil, \q habitante, fille de l’Égypte ! \q Car Memphis deviendra une désolation, \q et elle sera détruite, sans habitant.
fr.B: Prépare tes bagages pour l’exil, \q peuple de la fille d’Égypte ! \q Car Memphis deviendra un désert, \q une ruine où personne n’habite.
fr.R: Peuple d’Égypte, \q prépare tes bagages, car tu vas être emmené prisonnier ! \q La ville de Memphis deviendra une ruine vide. \q Personne n’y habitera plus.

sw.L: Jifanyie mizigo ya uhamisho, \q wewe ukaaye [huko], binti Misri! \q Kwa maana Memfisi itakuwa ukiwa, \q nao utaharibiwa kabisa, bila mkaaji.
sw.B: Fungeni mizigo yenu kwa ajili ya uhamisho, \q enyi watu wa Binti Misri! \q Kwa maana Memfisi itakuwa nyika, \q magofu yasiyo na mtu anayeishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Misri, \q fungeni mizigo yenu kwa sababu mtachukuliwa mateka! \q Mji wa Memfisi utakuwa magofu matupu. \q Hakuna mtu atakayeishi huko.

vi.L: Hãy sắm cho mình hành trang đi lưu đày, \q hỡi kẻ cư ngụ, con gái Ai Cập! \q Vì Mem-phít sẽ thành hoang phế, \q bị đổ nát, không còn dân cư.
vi.B: Hãy gói ghém hành trang đi lưu đày, \q hỡi dân cư của con gái Ai Cập! \q Vì Mem-phít sẽ thành chốn hoang tàn, \q một nơi đổ nát không người ở.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Ai Cập, \q hãy gói ghém hành trang để bị bắt đi làm tù binh! \q Thành Mem-phít sẽ thành đống đổ nát vắng tanh. \q Không ai sống ở đó nữa.

ko.L: 딸 이집트에 사는 자야, \q 포로로 끌려갈 짐을 꾸려라! \q 멤피스가 황무지가 되고, \q 불타 폐허가 되어 사는 사람이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 딸 이집트의 백성아, \q 포로로 끌려갈 짐을 꾸려라! \q 멤피스가 황무지가 되고, \q 아무도 살지 않는 폐허가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트 백성아, \q 포로로 끌려갈 짐을 꾸려라! \q 멤피스 성은 텅 빈 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 거기에 아무도 살지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Prepara para ti bagagem de exílio, \q tu que habitas [ali], filha do Egito! \q Pois Mênfis se tornará uma desolação, \q e será arrasada, sem morador.
pt.B: Arruma a tua bagagem para o exílio, \q povo da filha do Egito! \q Pois Mênfis se tornará um deserto, \q uma ruína onde ninguém mora.
pt.R: Povo do Egito, \q arruma a tua bagagem para seres levado como prisioneiro! \q A cidade de Mênfis vai virar uma ruína vazia. \q Ninguém vai morar lá.

am.L: በዚያ የምትኖሪ የግብፅ ልጅ ሆይ፣ \q ለምርኮ የሚሆን ጓዝ አዘጋጂ፤ \q ሜምፊስ ባድማ ትሆናለችና፤ \q የሚኖርባትም ሳይኖር ትፈራርሳለች።
am.B: የግብፅ ልጅ ነዋሪዎች ሆይ፣ \q ለምርኮ ጓዛችሁን አዘጋጁ! \q ሜምፊስ ባድማ ትሆናለችና፤ \q ሰው የማይኖርባት ፍርስራሽ ትሆናለች።
am.R: የግብፅ ሰዎች ሆይ፣ \q ተማርካችሁ ለመወሰድ ጓዛችሁን አዘጋጁ! \q የሜምፊስ ከተማ ሰው የሌለባት ፍርስራሽ ትሆናለች። \q በዚያ የሚኖር ማንም አይኖርም።

hi.L: हे मिस्र की बेटी, [वहाँ] रहनेवाली, \q बंधुआई के लिए अपना सामान बाँधो! \q क्योंकि मेम्फ़िस उजाड़ हो जाएगा, \q और वह खंडहर हो जाएगा, उसमें कोई निवासी न रहेगा।
hi.B: निर्वासन के लिए अपना सामान बाँध लो, \q हे मिस्र की बेटी के लोगो! \q क्योंकि मेम्फ़िस उजाड़ भूमि बन जाएगा, \q ऐसा खंडहर जिसमें कोई नहीं रहता।
hi.R: हे मिस्र के लोगो, \q बंदी बनाकर ले जाए जाने के लिए अपना सामान बाँध लो! \q मेम्फ़िस नगर एक सूना खंडहर बन जाएगा। \q वहाँ कोई नहीं रहेगा।

ru.L: Приготовь себе пожитки для изгнания, \q живущая [там], дочь Египта! \q Потому что Мемфис станет пустошью, \q и будет разрушен, без жителя.
ru.B: Собирай вещи в изгнание, \q народ, дочь Египта! \q Потому что Мемфис станет пустыней, \q развалинами, где никто не живёт.
ru.R: Народ Египта, \q собирай вещи: тебя уведут в плен! \q Город Мемфис станет пустыми развалинами. \q Никто не будет там жить.

uk.L: Зроби собі пожитки для вигнання, \q мешканко, доню Єгипту! \q Бо Мемфіс стане пусткою, \q і буде зруйнований, без мешканця.
uk.B: Збирай свої речі у вигнання, \q ви, люди Доні Єгипту! \q Бо Мемфіс стане пусткою, \q руїною, де ніхто не живе.
uk.R: Люди Єгипту, \q збирайте речі, бо вас заберуть у полон! \q Місто Мемфіс стане порожньою руїною. \q Ніхто там не житиме.

decisions.choice: baggage of exile: the few things a captive could carry
decisions.reason: People taken into exile walked with a small bundle on their shoulders (Ezekiel 12:3-7). Egypt, which hoped to cover the earth, is told to get ready to be led away.

decisions.choice: dweller daughter of Egypt: the people of Egypt, pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: The two words are joined: the one who lives as Daughter Egypt, that is, the people of the land pictured as a woman (verses 11, 24; compare 48:18, "dweller daughter of Dibon").

decisions.choice: be laid in ruins: be destroyed so that nothing stands
decisions.reason: The verb is used of cities laid waste (2:15; 4:7). Memphis, the old royal city (verse 14), will be left without people.

decisions.choice: you people of Daughter Egypt (Balanced); People of Egypt ... to be taken away as prisoners (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whom the words address (m2); Readable explains exile and adds "the city of".

source.text: עֶגְלָ֥ה יְפֵֽה־פִיָּ֖ה מִצְרָ֑יִם קֶ֥רֶץ מִצָּפ֖וֹן בָּ֥א בָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: A heifer very beautiful [is] Egypt; a gadfly from [the] north has come, has come.

en.L: A very beautiful heifer [is] Egypt; \q a gadfly from the north has come, has come!
en.B: Egypt is a lovely young heifer, \q but a gadfly from the north is coming, coming on!
en.R: Egypt is like a beautiful young cow. \q But a stinging fly from the north is coming to attack her!

es.L: Novilla hermosísima [es] Egipto; \q un tábano del norte viene, ¡viene!
es.B: Egipto es una hermosa novilla, \q pero un tábano del norte se acerca, ¡se acerca!
es.R: Egipto es como una vaca joven y hermosa. \q Pero un insecto que pica viene del norte a atacarla.

fr.L: Une génisse très belle, [c’est] l’Égypte ; \q un taon du nord est venu, il est venu !
fr.B: L’Égypte est une belle jeune génisse, \q mais un taon arrive du nord, il arrive !
fr.R: L’Égypte est comme une belle jeune vache. \q Mais une mouche qui pique arrive du nord pour l’attaquer !

sw.L: Misri [ni] mtamba mzuri sana; \q inzi wa kuuma kutoka kaskazini amekuja, amekuja!
sw.B: Misri ni mtamba mzuri mchanga, \q lakini inzi wa kuuma kutoka kaskazini anakuja, anakuja!
sw.R: Misri ni kama ng'ombe mchanga mzuri. \q Lakini inzi anayeuma kutoka kaskazini anakuja kumshambulia!

vi.L: Ai Cập [là] một con bò cái tơ rất đẹp; \q một con mòng từ phương bắc đã đến, đã đến!
vi.B: Ai Cập là một con bò cái tơ xinh đẹp, \q nhưng một con mòng từ phương bắc đang đến, đang lao tới!
vi.R: Ai Cập giống như một con bò cái tơ xinh đẹp. \q Nhưng một con ruồi trâu từ phương bắc đang đến đốt nó!

ko.L: 이집트는 아주 아름다운 암송아지다. \q 북쪽에서 쇠파리가 왔다, 왔다!
ko.B: 이집트는 아름다운 어린 암소다. \q 그러나 북쪽에서 쇠파리가 몰려온다, 몰려온다!
ko.R: 이집트는 아름다운 어린 암소와 같다. \q 그러나 북쪽에서 쏘는 파리가 그를 공격하러 오고 있다!

pt.L: Novilha muito formosa [é] o Egito; \q um moscardo do norte veio, veio!
pt.B: O Egito é uma linda novilha, \q mas um moscardo do norte está vindo, vindo!
pt.R: O Egito é como uma bela vaca nova. \q Mas uma mosca que ferroa está vindo do norte para atacá-la!

am.L: ግብፅ እጅግ የተዋበች ጊደር [ናት]፤ \q ከሰሜን ተናዳፊ ዝንብ መጣ፤ መጣ!
am.B: ግብፅ ያማረች ጊደር ናት፤ \q ነገር ግን ከሰሜን ተናዳፊ ዝንብ እየመጣ ነው፤ እየመጣባት ነው!
am.R: ግብፅ እንደ ቆንጆ ጊደር ናት። \q ነገር ግን ከሰሜን የሚናደፍ ዝንብ ሊወጋት እየመጣ ነው!

hi.L: मिस्र बहुत सुंदर बछिया [है]; \q उत्तर से एक डाँस आया है, आया है!
hi.B: मिस्र एक सुंदर जवान बछिया है, \q पर उत्तर से एक डाँस आ रहा है, आता ही चला आ रहा है!
hi.R: मिस्र एक सुंदर जवान गाय की तरह है। \q पर उत्तर से एक डंक मारनेवाली मक्खी उस पर हमला करने आ रही है!

ru.L: Прекрасная телица — Египет; \q овод с севера пришёл, пришёл!
ru.B: Египет — прекрасная молодая телица, \q но овод с севера летит, летит на неё!
ru.R: Египет похож на красивую молодую корову. \q Но с севера летит жалящая муха, чтобы напасть на неё!

uk.L: Дуже гарна телиця — Єгипет; \q ґедзь з півночі прийшов, прийшов!
uk.B: Єгипет — гарна молода телиця, \q але ґедзь з півночі летить, налітає!
uk.R: Єгипет — як гарна молода корова. \q Але з півночі летить жалючий ґедзь, щоб напасти на неї!

decisions.choice: gadfly: a biting fly that torments cattle
decisions.reason: The word is found only here. It comes from a root meaning "to nip" or "pinch", and in a herd picture it most likely means a biting fly such as a gadfly or horsefly, which drives cattle wild. Others understand it as "destruction" or "one who cuts off". Either way, the enemy from the north attacks the sleek heifer.

decisions.choice: a very beautiful heifer: Egypt, sleek and well fed
decisions.reason: The rare doubled word means "very pretty". A young cow fattened in good pasture pictures a rich, untroubled land (compare Hosea 10:11; Amos 4:1). It may also glance at Egypt's honor for sacred cattle (verse 15).

decisions.choice: has come, has come: the Hebrew repeats the verb
decisions.reason: The doubled verb gives urgency: it is coming, it is here. Many Hebrew manuscripts and some ancient translations read the second word with one more letter, "has come against her". The meaning is close. This is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: lovely young heifer; coming, coming on (Balanced); like a beautiful young cow; stinging fly ... to attack her (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the doubled verb as "coming, coming on". Readable makes the picture a comparison, says "stinging fly" for gadfly (m1), and says what the fly will do.

decisions.choice: con mòng (L, B); con ruồi trâu (R)
decisions.reason: The gadfly is a biting fly that torments cattle; "mòng" names it, and Readable uses the more familiar "ruồi trâu".

decisions.choice: बछिया; डाँस (L, B), डंक मारनेवाली मक्खी (R)
decisions.reason: The heifer and the gadfly (a biting fly that drives cattle wild); डाँस is the Hindi name of that fly, explained at Readable, as the English "stinging fly".

decisions.choice: "овод" (L, B); "жалящая муха" (R)
decisions.reason: A biting fly that torments cattle (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the doubled verb (m3).

source.text: גַּם־שְׂכִרֶ֤יהָ בְקִרְבָּהּ֙ כְּעֶגְלֵ֣י מַרְבֵּ֔ק כִּֽי־גַם־הֵ֧מָּה הִפְנ֛וּ נָ֥סוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו לֹ֣א עָמָ֑דוּ כִּ֣י י֥וֹם אֵידָ֛ם בָּ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Also her hired [soldiers] in her midst [are] like calves of [the] stall; for also they have turned, they have fled together, not they stood; for [the] day of their calamity has come upon them, [the] time of their punishment.

en.L: Even her hired soldiers in her midst [are] like calves of the stall; \q for they too have turned, they have fled together, they did not stand; \q for the day of their calamity has come upon them, the time of their punishment.
en.B: Even the hired soldiers in her ranks are like fattened calves; \q they too have turned and fled together, they did not stand their ground; \q for the day of their disaster has come upon them, the time of their punishment.
en.R: Even the soldiers Egypt hired are like fat calves ready to be killed. \q They too turn and run away together. They do not stand and fight. \q The day of their disaster has come. It is time for them to be punished.

es.L: También sus mercenarios en medio de ella [son] como becerros de engorde; \q porque también ellos se volvieron, huyeron juntos, no se mantuvieron en pie; \q porque vino sobre ellos el día de su calamidad, el tiempo de su castigo.
es.B: Hasta los soldados que contrató son como becerros cebados; \q también ellos dieron la vuelta y huyeron juntos, no resistieron; \q porque les llegó el día de su desgracia, el tiempo de su castigo.
es.R: Hasta los soldados que Egipto contrató son como becerros gordos listos para el matadero. \q También ellos dan la vuelta y huyen juntos. No se quedan a pelear. \q Les ha llegado el día de la desgracia. Es hora de que sean castigados.

fr.L: Même ses mercenaires au milieu d’elle [sont] comme des veaux d’étable ; \q car eux aussi ont tourné le dos, ils se sont enfuis ensemble, ils n’ont pas tenu bon ; \q car le jour de leur désastre est venu sur eux, le temps de leur châtiment.
fr.B: Même les mercenaires qui sont dans ses rangs sont comme des veaux engraissés ; \q eux aussi ont tourné le dos et se sont enfuis ensemble, ils n’ont pas tenu bon ; \q car le jour de leur désastre est venu sur eux, le temps de leur châtiment.
fr.R: Même les soldats que l’Égypte a payés sont comme des veaux gras prêts à être abattus. \q Eux aussi font demi-tour et s’enfuient tous ensemble. Ils ne restent pas pour se battre. \q Le jour de leur désastre est arrivé. Le moment est venu de les punir.

sw.L: Hata askari wake wa kukodiwa walio katikati yake [ni] kama ndama wa zizini; \q kwa maana wao nao wamegeuka, wamekimbia pamoja, hawakusimama; \q kwa maana siku ya msiba wao imewajia, wakati wa kuadhibiwa kwao.
sw.B: Hata askari wa kukodiwa walio katika jeshi lake ni kama ndama walionenepeshwa; \q wao nao wamegeuka na kukimbia pamoja, hawakusimama imara; \q kwa maana siku ya maafa yao imewajia, wakati wa kuadhibiwa kwao.
sw.R: Hata askari ambao Misri iliwakodi ni kama ndama wanono walio tayari kuchinjwa. \q Wao nao wanageuka na kukimbia pamoja. Hawasimami kupigana. \q Siku ya maafa yao imefika. Ni wakati wa wao kuadhibiwa.

vi.L: Ngay cả lính đánh thuê giữa nó [cũng] như bò con trong chuồng; \q vì chúng cũng quay lưng, cùng nhau chạy trốn, chúng không đứng vững; \q vì ngày tai họa của chúng đã đến trên chúng, thời kỳ chúng bị phạt.
vi.B: Ngay cả lính đánh thuê trong hàng ngũ nó cũng như bò con được vỗ béo; \q chúng cũng quay lưng chạy trốn cả loạt, không đứng vững được; \q vì ngày tai họa của chúng đã đến, thời kỳ chúng bị trừng phạt.
vi.R: Ngay cả quân lính Ai Cập thuê mướn cũng như bò con mập béo sắp bị làm thịt. \q Chúng cũng quay lưng cùng nhau bỏ chạy. Chúng không đứng lại chiến đấu. \q Ngày tai họa của chúng đã đến. Đã đến lúc chúng bị trừng phạt.

ko.L: 그 가운데 있는 그의 품꾼들도 외양간의 송아지들 같다. \q 그들도 돌아서서 함께 도망하고 서지 못했다. \q 그들의 재앙의 날, 그들이 벌받을 때가 그들에게 닥쳤기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이집트 군대 안에 있는 용병들도 살진 송아지들 같다. \q 그들도 돌아서서 함께 달아나고, 버티지 못했다. \q 그들이 재앙을 당할 날, 벌받을 때가 닥쳤기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이집트가 돈을 주고 데려온 군인들도 잡아먹으려고 살찌운 송아지들 같다. \q 그들도 돌아서서 함께 달아난다. 그들은 버티고 싸우지 않는다. \q 그들이 재앙을 당할 날이 왔다. 그들이 벌을 받을 때가 되었다.

pt.L: Também os seus mercenários no meio dela [são] como bezerros de estábulo; \q pois também eles se voltaram, fugiram juntos, não ficaram de pé; \q pois o dia da sua calamidade veio sobre eles, o tempo do seu castigo.
pt.B: Até os soldados contratados que estão nas suas fileiras são como bezerros cevados; \q também eles deram meia-volta e fugiram juntos, não resistiram; \q pois chegou para eles o dia da sua desgraça, o tempo do seu castigo.
pt.R: Até os soldados que o Egito contratou são como bezerros gordos prontos para o abate. \q Eles também dão meia-volta e fogem juntos. Não ficam para lutar. \q Chegou o dia da desgraça deles. Chegou a hora de serem castigados.

am.L: በመካከሏ ያሉት ቅጥረኞቿ ደግሞ እንደ ሰቡ ጥጆች [ናቸው]፤ \q እነርሱም ደግሞ ዞረው በአንድነት ሸሽተዋልና፤ አልቆሙም፤ \q የመከራቸው ቀን፣ የቅጣታቸውም ጊዜ መጥቶባቸዋልና።
am.B: በሠራዊቷ ውስጥ ያሉት ቅጥረኛ ወታደሮች እንኳ እንደ ሰቡ ጥጆች ናቸው፤ \q እነርሱም ደግሞ ዞረው በአንድነት ሸሹ፤ ጸንተው አልቆሙም፤ \q የጥፋታቸው ቀን፣ የቅጣታቸውም ጊዜ መጥቶባቸዋልና።
am.R: ግብፅ የቀጠረቻቸው ወታደሮች እንኳ ለእርድ እንደ ተዘጋጁ የሰቡ ጥጆች ናቸው። \q እነርሱም ደግሞ ዞረው በአንድነት ይሸሻሉ። ቆመው አይዋጉም። \q የጥፋታቸው ቀን መጥቷል። የሚቀጡበት ጊዜ ደርሷል።

hi.L: उसके बीच उसके भाड़े के सैनिक भी थान के बछड़ों के समान [हैं]; \q क्योंकि वे भी मुड़ गए, वे एक साथ भाग गए, वे खड़े न रहे; \q क्योंकि उनकी विपत्ति का दिन, उनके दंड का समय, उन पर आ पहुँचा है।
hi.B: उसकी सेना के भाड़े के सैनिक भी मोटे किए हुए बछड़ों जैसे हैं; \q वे भी मुड़कर एक साथ भाग गए, वे टिक न सके; \q क्योंकि उनकी विपत्ति का दिन, उनके दंड का समय, उन पर आ पहुँचा है।
hi.R: मिस्र ने जो सैनिक भाड़े पर रखे, वे भी मोटे बछड़ों जैसे हैं जो काटे जाने को तैयार हों। \q वे भी मुड़कर एक साथ भाग जाते हैं। वे डटकर नहीं लड़ते। \q उनकी विपत्ति का दिन आ गया है। उनके दंड का समय आ पहुँचा है।

ru.L: Даже его наёмники посреди него — как откормленные телята; \q потому что и они повернули, побежали вместе, не устояли; \q потому что день их бедствия пришёл на них, время их наказания.
ru.B: Даже наёмники в его войске — как откормленные телята; \q и они повернули и побежали все вместе, не устояли; \q потому что пришёл на них день их бедствия, время их наказания.
ru.R: Даже воины, которых Египет нанял, похожи на откормленных телят, готовых на убой. \q Они тоже поворачиваются и все вместе убегают. Они не стоят и не сражаются. \q Пришёл день их беды. Пришло время им быть наказанными.

uk.L: Навіть її наймані вояки посеред неї — як телята відгодовані; \q бо й вони обернулися, утекли разом, не встояли; \q бо прийшов на них день їхнього лиха, час їхньої кари.
uk.B: Навіть наймані вояки в її лавах — як відгодовані телята; \q і вони теж обернулися й разом утекли, не встояли на місці; \q бо прийшов на них день їхнього лиха, час їхньої кари.
uk.R: Навіть воїни, яких Єгипет найняв, — як відгодовані телята, готові на заріз. \q Вони теж обертаються і разом тікають. Вони не стоять і не борються. \q Настав день їхнього лиха. Настав час їм бути покараними.

decisions.choice: hired soldiers: the foreign mercenaries in Egypt's army
decisions.reason: Egypt's army in this period relied heavily on hired troops from other lands, such as those named in verse 9. They are the ones who say "let us go back to our own people" in verse 16.

decisions.choice: calves of the stall: animals fattened for slaughter
decisions.reason: Calves kept in the stall were fed up to be killed for a feast (Amos 6:4; 1 Samuel 28:24). The well-paid soldiers are ready for the LORD's "sacrifice" (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the time of their punishment: the time when God calls them to account
decisions.reason: The noun is from the verb "to visit", used of God coming to deal with someone, here in judgment (8:12; 10:15; 11:23).

decisions.choice: fat calves ready to be killed
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the fattened calves picture (m2).

decisions.choice: "품꾼들" (L); "용병들" (B); "돈을 주고 데려온 군인들" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "hired men"; Balanced uses the modern word for mercenaries, and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "его наёмники ... посреди него"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures Egypt as a woman ("her"); Египет is masculine in Russian, so the pronouns follow Russian grammar, as in 8:19.

source.text: קוֹלָ֖הּ כַּנָּחָ֣שׁ יֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־בְחַ֣יִל יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְקַרְדֻּמּוֹת֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔הּ כְּחֹטְבֵ֖י עֵצִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Her sound like a snake [that] goes, for in strength they go, and with axes they come to her, like cutters of trees.

en.L: Her sound is like a snake that goes away, \q for they march in force \q and come against her with axes, \q like those who cut down trees.
en.B: She makes a sound like a snake slithering away, \q as her enemies march in force \q and come at her with axes, \q like woodcutters felling trees.
en.R: Egypt hisses like a snake as it slides away, \q because her enemies are coming with a strong army. \q They come at her with axes, \q like woodcutters cutting down trees.

es.L: Su sonido es como el de una serpiente que se va, \q porque marchan con fuerza \q y vienen contra ella con hachas, \q como los que cortan árboles.
es.B: Hace un ruido como de serpiente que se escabulle, \q mientras sus enemigos avanzan con fuerza \q y vienen contra ella con hachas, \q como leñadores que talan árboles.
es.R: Egipto silba como una serpiente que se escapa arrastrándose, \q porque sus enemigos vienen con un ejército poderoso. \q Vienen contra ella con hachas, \q como leñadores que cortan árboles.

fr.L: Sa voix est comme [celle d’]un serpent qui s’en va, \q car ils marchent en force \q et viennent contre elle avec des haches, \q comme ceux qui abattent les arbres.
fr.B: Elle fait entendre un bruit comme un serpent qui s’enfuit, \q car ses ennemis avancent en force \q et viennent contre elle avec des haches, \q comme des bûcherons qui abattent des arbres.
fr.R: L’Égypte siffle comme un serpent qui s’enfuit en glissant, \q parce que ses ennemis arrivent avec une armée puissante. \q Ils viennent contre elle avec des haches, \q comme des bûcherons qui coupent des arbres.

sw.L: Sauti yake ni kama ya nyoka aendaye zake, \q kwa maana wanakuja kwa nguvu, \q nao wanamjia na mashoka, \q kama wakataji wa miti.
sw.B: Anatoa sauti kama nyoka anayeteleza akikimbia, \q adui zake wanapokuja kwa nguvu \q na kumjia na mashoka, \q kama wakata miti wanaoangusha miti.
sw.R: Misri inazomea kama nyoka anayeteleza akikimbia, \q kwa sababu adui zake wanakuja na jeshi lenye nguvu. \q Wanamjia na mashoka, \q kama wakata miti wanaokata miti.

vi.L: Tiếng nó như tiếng con rắn bò đi, \q vì chúng kéo đến với lực lượng hùng mạnh, \q và mang rìu đến đánh nó \q như những kẻ đốn cây.
vi.B: Nó phát ra tiếng như con rắn trườn đi, \q khi quân thù kéo đến đông đảo \q và mang rìu đến đánh nó \q như tiều phu đốn cây.
vi.R: Ai Cập rít lên như con rắn đang trườn đi, \q vì quân thù kéo đến với một đạo quân hùng mạnh. \q Chúng mang rìu đến đánh nó \q như tiều phu chặt cây.

ko.L: 그의 소리가 기어가는 뱀 같다. \q 그들이 대군을 이끌고 진군하며, \q 도끼를 들고 그에게 온다. \q 나무를 찍는 자들처럼.
ko.B: 이집트는 기어서 달아나는 뱀처럼 쉿쉿 소리를 낸다. \q 원수들이 대군을 이끌고 진군하여 \q 도끼를 들고 그에게 쳐들어온다. \q 나무를 베는 나무꾼들처럼.
ko.R: 이집트는 미끄러져 달아나는 뱀처럼 쉿쉿 소리를 낸다. \q 원수들이 강한 군대를 이끌고 오고 있기 때문이다. \q 그들은 도끼를 들고 이집트에 쳐들어온다. \q 나무를 베어 넘기는 나무꾼들처럼.

pt.L: A voz dela é como a da serpente que se vai, \q pois eles marcham com força \q e vêm contra ela com machados, \q como os que cortam árvores.
pt.B: Ela faz um som como de serpente que foge rastejando, \q enquanto os inimigos marcham com força \q e vêm contra ela com machados, \q como lenhadores derrubando árvores.
pt.R: O Egito sibila como uma cobra que vai embora rastejando, \q porque os seus inimigos estão vindo com um exército forte. \q Eles vêm contra ela com machados, \q como lenhadores que cortam árvores.

am.L: ድምፅዋ እንደሚሄድ እባብ ነው፤ \q በኃይል ይዘምታሉና፤ \q ዛፍ እንደሚቆርጡ ሰዎች \q መጥረቢያ ይዘው ወደ እርሷ ይመጣሉ።
am.B: ግብፅ እንደሚሸሽ እባብ ታንሾካሹካለች፤ \q ጠላቶቿ በኃይል ይዘምታሉና፤ \q ዛፍ እንደሚቆርጡ እንጨት ቆራጮች \q መጥረቢያ ይዘው ይመጡባታል።
am.R: ግብፅ እየተሳበ እንደሚሄድ እባብ ታፏጫለች፤ \q ጠላቶቿ በብርቱ ሠራዊት ይመጡባታልና። \q ዛፍ እንደሚቆርጡ እንጨት ቆራጮች \q መጥረቢያ ይዘው ይመጡባታል።

hi.L: उसकी आवाज़ जाते हुए साँप के समान है, \q क्योंकि वे सेना लेकर चलते हैं \q और कुल्हाड़ियाँ लिए हुए उस पर आते हैं, \q पेड़ काटनेवालों के समान।
hi.B: वह सरकते हुए साँप की तरह सरसराती है, \q क्योंकि उसके शत्रु दल-बल के साथ बढ़ते हैं \q और कुल्हाड़ियाँ लेकर उस पर टूट पड़ते हैं, \q पेड़ गिरानेवाले लकड़हारों की तरह।
hi.R: मिस्र सरकते हुए साँप की तरह फुफकारता है, \q क्योंकि उसके शत्रु बड़ी सेना लेकर आ रहे हैं। \q वे कुल्हाड़ियाँ लेकर उस पर आते हैं, \q जैसे लकड़हारे पेड़ काटने आते हैं।

ru.L: Голос его — как у змеи, что уползает, \q потому что они идут с силой \q и с топорами приходят на него, \q как рубящие деревья.
ru.B: Он издаёт звук, как змея, ускользающая прочь, \q когда его враги идут с силой \q и нападают на него с топорами, \q как дровосеки, валящие деревья.
ru.R: Египет шипит, как змея, когда уползает, \q потому что враги идут на него с сильным войском. \q Они нападают на него с топорами, \q как дровосеки, рубящие деревья.

uk.L: Її голос — як у змії, що відповзає, \q бо вони йдуть із силою \q і приходять на неї з сокирами, \q як ті, що рубають дерева.
uk.B: Вона сичить, мов змія, що відповзає, \q коли її вороги наступають із силою \q і йдуть на неї з сокирами, \q як дроворуби, що валять дерева.
uk.R: Єгипет сичить, як змія, що відповзає, \q бо вороги наступають з великим військом. \q Вони йдуть на нього з сокирами, \q як дроворуби, що рубають дерева.

decisions.choice: her sound like a snake that goes: the faint hiss of a snake escaping
decisions.reason: Egypt rose roaring like the Nile (verses 7-8) and Pharaoh was a "noise" (verse 17). Now all that is heard is the rustle and hiss of a snake slipping away through the undergrowth as the woodcutters come.

decisions.choice: they: the invaders from the north
decisions.reason: "They" are not named; they are the enemy of verses 20 and 24, the people of the north.

decisions.choice: with axes, like woodcutters: the army pictured as felling a forest
decisions.reason: The picture continues into verse 23: the invaders cut down Egypt like trees (compare 22:7; Isaiah 10:33-34, of Assyria).

decisions.choice: slithering away (Balanced); hisses ... slides away (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of sound and movement the picture means (m1); Readable supplies "hisses" and names Egypt.

source.text: כָּרְת֤וּ יַעְרָהּ֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י לֹ֣א יֵֽחָקֵ֑ר כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ מֵֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מִסְפָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: They have cut down her forest, declares Yahweh, though not it can be searched; for they are more numerous than locusts, and there is not to them number.

en.L: They have cut down her forest, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q though it cannot be searched out; \q for they are more numerous than locusts, \q and there is no number to them.
en.B: They will cut down her forest, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q dense as it is, \q for they are more than locusts; \q they cannot be counted.
en.R: They will cut down her forest, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q even though it is too thick to walk through. \q The enemy soldiers are more than a swarm of locusts. \q No one can count them.

es.L: Cortaron su bosque, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q aunque no se puede recorrer; \q porque son más numerosos que las langostas, \q y no tienen número.
es.B: Cortarán su bosque, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q por espeso que sea, \q porque son más que las langostas; \q no se pueden contar.
